generate_300vw_list: generate 300VW dataset train and test split list files from a root directory
load_video_dir: load video frames and annotations from directories then write list files to disk
str2size: compute the bounding box area from a space-separated x1 y1 x2 y2 string
run_generate_300VW: run the script to generate 300VW dataset list files using DOME_HOME or HOME env var
review_generate_300VW: review the 300VW dataset generation script for frame annotation list file creation
